purpose: Define fail-closed row-level comparison of TPEx T_PRELIM, T1_REVISED and T2_FINAL so revisions are not understated by common-row-only comparisons or missing-as-zero imputation.
unionDenominatorRule: Compare the union of symbol identities across adjacent vintages. Common-support summaries may be reported separately but must not replace the union-denominator audit.

rowStates.UNCHANGED: symbol exists in both vintages and all compared source fields are identical
rowStates.CHANGED: symbol exists in both vintages and at least one compared source field differs
rowStates.ADDED_IN_LATER: symbol absent in earlier vintage and present in later vintage
rowStates.REMOVED_IN_LATER: symbol present in earlier vintage and absent in later vintage
rowStates.UNKNOWN_IDENTITY_CONFLICT: duplicate/malformed symbol identity or schema mismatch prevents safe comparison

safeguards: Missing row in either vintage is not numeric zero.
Do not restrict revision analysis to common rows without separately reporting added/removed rows.
Do not divide by an earlier value of zero without an explicit zero-base state; relative revision is UNKNOWN or separately bucketed.
Do not infer return direction from buy-value minus sell-value revisions.
Do not infer investor identity or motive from day-trading revisions.
T2_FINAL may validate finality but must never replace the preserved T_PRELIM first-known state.
A later scraper/parser change must not be confused with a provider data revision; schema/parser version must be preserved.
Universe additions/removals, suspension-state changes and numeric revisions are separate revision mechanisms.
maturityRule: One T_PRELIM receipt is insufficient for L3. At minimum preserve same-date T_PRELIM and subsequent revision/finality vintages with identity-safe comparison; broader independent-date stability is still preferred before predictive outcome work.
exactNext: Apply this contract to 2026-10-05 T_PRELIM versus 2026-10-06 T1_REVISED, then T1_REVISED versus 2026-10-07 T2_FINAL and T_PRELIM versus T2_FINAL. Preserve both union and common-support metrics.
